## Freed v26.9.1400

More reliable Google Drive transfers and synchronized edits

### Fixes

- The same enrolled writer identity for checkpoint and operation sync, fixing accepted PWA edits blocked by an invalid writer error. now uses the correct path
- Refresh Google Drive credentials during long transfers so checkpoint imports can continue after the original access token expires
- Valid device enrollment from a verified checkpoint now recover when an older client retained a different local request
- Accept the complete saved and archived state returned by Freed Desktop when clearing an optimistic PWA edit

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
